note: The kit theme registry (#1852 Phase 3) — the ONE source of truth for the SDK's THEME axis. A theme is a map of overrides for the semantic component tokens (`--card-*`/`--btn-*`/`--field-*`/`--chip-*`, defined in src/styles/tokens.css). Applying a theme sets those CSS custom properties — globally on :root (via appearance/useAppBoot, same mechanism as the accent) or scoped on a subtree (via <ThemeScope>, for a coexisting themed card or an isolated live preview). This file is read by BOTH faces: the frontend (`src/shared/ui/kit/theme.ts` loads it + applies it) AND `bsc ui theme list|get` (crates/bsc-ui embeds it), so a live agent can enumerate + read themes from its own shell. `default` (empty overrides) is the base look; the rest retint the same components without touching any card's spec/structure. Values reference base tokens so a theme composes with light/dark + the chosen accent.

themes.label: Soft
